# How much should you charge to ghostwrite this book? Price it from your hours.

> Free ghostwriter quote calculator: build a book fee from drafting, interview, research and revision hours, add confidentiality and rush premiums, see per-word and per-page rates, a payment schedule and what a client's lower budget really pays you. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
